reasoning: Each criticism maps heights l..floor((l+r)/2) to l-1 and the rest to r+1; odd r-l makes these nearest endpoints unique. An ordered treap holds current height groups and supports range isolation. Disjoint-set representatives bind individual buildings to groups, so merging a whole range never requires revisiting every building. Individual reassignment installs a fresh handle and cannot be affected by later merges of its former group. Every collapsed treap node is removed, giving amortized work proportional to initial groups plus created groups, with logarithmic ordered operations and path-compressed union by size.
